page: Cookie handling in Elysia for HTTP cookie management. Reactive cookie object accessed from context. cookie destructuring from context. visit.value for cookie value access. visit.value++ for mutation. httpOnly attribute security flag. Cookie schema validation with t.Object. Cookie signature prevention of tampering. secret option in Elysia constructor. t.Cookie() for per-cookie secrets. Multiple secrets rotation support. .remove() method to delete cookies. sameSite, secure, maxAge attributes. .set() for bulk attribute setting. Questions: How do I access cookies? How do I validate cookies? How do I sign cookies? How do I delete cookies?

Elysia coerces to respective value type. visit.value with type annotation. t.Object({ visit: t.Optional(t.Object({ total: t.Number() })) }) pattern. Cookie schema validation. Optional cookies with t.Optional. Nested object values. Questions: How do I type cookie values? How do I validate cookie structure?

Cookie attributes for security and control. httpOnly attribute prevents JavaScript access. path attribute for cookie scope. sameSite attribute: 'lax' for CSRF protection. secure attribute for HTTPS only. maxAge seconds for expiration (60*60*24*7 for 7 days). Attribute property assignment visit.httpOnly = true. .set() bulk attribute configuration. Questions: What cookie attributes exist? How do I make cookies HTTPOnly? How do I set expiration?
Cookie deletion and removal. .remove() method for deletion. Returns empty state. Cookie cleared from response. Questions: How do I delete cookies? How do I remove cookies?

Cookie signing for tampering prevention. secret configuration in Elysia constructor. t.Cookie() for schema with signature. secrets option array. sign option array of field names to sign. Multiple secrets rotation. First secret for signing, rest for verification. Preventing cookie tampering and forgery. Questions: How do I sign cookies? How do I rotate cookie secrets? What's the difference between secret and secrets?
